evals.prompt: tolong refine soal-soal kuis di cli/content/data/prod, fokus aja ke chapter 1 dulu. Mau cek alur deskripsi -> pertanyaan -> opsi udah nyambung belum, dan sinkron sama gambarnya. Pretest jangan disentuh ya. Ohiya sekalian cek juga apakah deskripsi-deskripsinya udah bikin siswa SMK ngerasa lagi journey kayak penjelajah, bukan ngerjain LKS biasa.
evals.expected_output: Skill executes phase 1 (plan) — reads chapter-1-tcp-ip.json and image-assignments.json, prints scope summary listing audit dimensions including Voice & Journey, and asks user to confirm scope. Does NOT auto-edit. Does NOT touch pretest.json or studyMaterial.
expectations: The agent reads chapter-1-tcp-ip.json from cli/content/data/prod/
The agent reads image-assignments.json from cli/content/data/prod/
The agent does NOT read pretest.json
The agent prints a phase-1 scope summary listing chapter, levels, total questions, and image count
The scope summary mentions Voice & Journey as one of the audit dimensions
The agent asks the user to confirm scope before proceeding to audit
The agent does NOT call Edit or Write on any chapter JSON in this turn
The agent does NOT modify any studyMaterial field

evals.prompt: audit semua soal kuis chapter 2 (WLAN), bikin change map yang nunjukin before/after tiap perubahan, terus tunggu approval gw sebelum apply. Pengecoh yang terlalu jelas salah tolong direwrite biar jawaban benernya gak ketebak. Penting banget — gw mau hook deskripsinya bener-bener pull siswa masuk ke skenario, bikin mereka ngerasa 'oh my god kita lagi di tengah journey'. Hook yang flat tipe 'WLAN adalah ...' tolong di-rewrite jadi adegan nyata yang relatable buat anak SMK.
evals.expected_output: Skill executes phases 1-4: confirms scope on chapter 2, audits all questions including the Voice & Journey dimension (V1/V2/V3 rule codes), produces a change map with verbatim Before/After, and stops at approval gate. Distractor rewrites address obvious-wrongness. Flat hooks rewritten to relatable SMK scenarios. No edits applied without explicit approval.
expectations: The agent reads chapter-2-wlan.json
The agent produces a change map with Before/After diffs in the format from change-map-format.md
The change map references options as 'Opsi A/B/C/D' for user readability
Each finding cites a specific rule code (M-, K-, B-, V-, PUEBI, KBBI, or SPOK)
At least one finding cites V1, V2, or V3 (Voice & Journey) explaining a flat hook or chore-y CTA
At least one distractor rewrite is proposed for an option that was 'obviously wrong'
Voice & Journey rewrites preserve baku Indonesian and don't introduce slang or emoji
The agent ends with the approval prompt and stops — no Edit calls fired
isCorrect flags are not changed; if a key issue is suspected it is flagged as KEY-CHECK
studyMaterial fields are untouched

evals.prompt: perbaiki soal di chapter-1-tcp-ip.json level 1 question 3 — deskripsinya nyebut 'Gambar di atas menampilkan three-way handshake' tapi gw mau pastiin gambarnya emang itu, dan kalimat deskripsinya udah baku belum sesuai PUEBI/SPOK. Bonus: kalau hook-nya kerasa kering, polish biar siswa kerasa lagi ada di journey. Setelah lo kasih change map, gw bilang 'Setuju Q1L1Q3' dan lo apply.
evals.expected_output: Skill scopes to a single question, cross-checks image against image-assignments.json, audits the description against PUEBI/SPOK and Voice & Journey, produces a focused change map, and applies the edit only after explicit approval with 'Setuju Q1L1Q3'. The applied file remains valid JSON with original formatting.
expectations: The agent cross-references image-assignments.json to confirm chapter 1 / level 1 / q3 image is ch1-three-way-handshake.png
The agent's change map covers only chapter 1 / level 1 / q3 (not other questions)
The change map includes at least one finding citing PUEBI, SPOK, or V1/V2 (Voice & Journey)
The agent stops at the approval gate before any Edit
After the user replies with 'Setuju Q1L1Q3', the agent applies the edit using exact-string Edit
The agent prints a post-apply summary listing the file touched and field changed
The original JSON formatting (indentation, key order) is preserved in the edited file
The post-edit file is valid JSON parseable by `python -m json.tool`
